short_name: USCG Cybersecurity in the Marine Transportation System final rule
summary: Requires a Cybersecurity Officer, Cybersecurity Assessment, Coast Guard-approved Cybersecurity Plan, training, drills, KEV patching, supply-chain and incident-response measures, and reporting of reportable cyber incidents.
applies_to: Owners/operators of U.S.-flagged vessels, MTSA-regulated facilities (33 CFR Part 105) and Outer Continental Shelf facilities (33 CFR Part 106) required to have security plans; not foreign-flagged vessels.
size_thresholds: No size threshold; applicability is by MTSA facility/vessel/OCS facility status (33 CFR 101.605).
status: Effective July 16, 2025. Training deadline Jan. 12, 2026; Cybersecurity Assessment and Cybersecurity Plan submission due no later than July 16, 2027 (33 CFR 101.650, 101.655).

short_name: TSA Security Directive Pipeline-2021-02G (Pipeline Cybersecurity Mitigation Actions, Contingency Planning, and Testing)
citation: TSA SD Pipeline-2021-02G, issued under 49 U.S.C. 114
summary: Requires a TSA-approved Cybersecurity Implementation Plan, an up-to-date Cybersecurity Incident Response Plan, and a Cybersecurity Assessment Program with testing.
applies_to: Owner/operators of TSA-designated critical hazardous liquid and natural gas pipelines or LNG facilities notified by TSA.
size_thresholds: No numeric threshold; applies to TSA-notified critical pipeline systems/facilities.
status: SD 02G effective May 3, 2026, expires May 2, 2027; supersedes 02F. TSA's proposed permanent rule 'Enhancing Surface Cyber Risk Management' (NPRM Nov. 7, 2024; 49 CFR Parts 1570/1580/1582/1586 etc.) is not yet final as of 2026-09-25.

short_name: CIRCIA (Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act of 2022) - proposed 6 CFR Part 226
citation: 6 U.S.C. 681-681g; proposed 6 CFR Part 226 (NPRM 89 FR 23644, Apr. 4, 2024)
summary: Would require covered entities to report covered cyber incidents to CISA within 72 hours and ransom payments within 24 hours, and preserve related data.
applies_to: Entities in a critical infrastructure sector that exceed the SBA small-business size standard for their NAICS code, or meet a sector-based criterion. Relevant sector criteria: owns/operates MTSA vessel/facility or OCS facility (33 CFR 104-106); TSA-designated pipeline (49 CFR 1586.101 as proposed).
size_thresholds: Proposed 226.2(a): exceeds SBA size standard in 13 CFR Part 121 for the entity's NAICS code (employee- or revenue-based depending on NAICS); sector-based criteria apply regardless of size.
status: NOT YET IN EFFECT. NPRM published Apr. 4, 2024; comment period closed Jul. 3, 2024; CISA held additional town halls in 2026 (FR notices Feb. 13, 2026 and May 26, 2026) on scope and burden. Fall 2025 Unified Agenda projected the final rule for 09/2026; no final rule found in the Federal Register as of 2026-09-25. Reporting obligations begin only on the final rule's effective date.
